reading.title: Meeting New People
reading.text: Meeting new people can be fun. When you meet someone for the first time, you usually say 'Hi' or 'Hello'. Then you say your name. For example: 'Hi, I'm Mai.' The other person says their name too. After that, you can ask questions. 'Where are you from?' and 'What do you do?' are common questions. People often talk about work, family, and hobbies. When you leave, you say 'Nice to meet you' or 'See you later'. It is polite to smile and make eye contact. Meeting new people is a good way to make friends and learn about different cultures.
